summary: Choose three repeatable battlefields and reuse prepared terrain and routes.
stage: Game overview and small-window menu captures
rationale: Uncropped real renders show the three distinct layouts; the selector shows the player control. Measured performance and its limits are recorded in docs/performance/loading-study.md.

capture.provenance: Captured during implementation of 1b52c9d8. Alder and Stonebridge overviews precede the final navigation-array copy fixes; generated/restored geometry parity was revalidated on the final build. Day lighting, high preset; no synthetic gameplay imagery.
capture.composition: Three complete 1280x720 source frames resized to 800x450, with plain labels; 1600x970 JPEG. Selector is complete 960x600 JPEG.
